# Toddle

> Toddle (toddlekids.com) is a free UK nursery finder. Parents search by town, county or postcode to find and compare 1,021 day nurseries, pre-schools and nursery schools across 45 counties in England, then contact a nursery directly. It costs parents nothing.

Each nursery page shows, where the nursery has provided it:
- The latest Ofsted rating, with the sub-grades and a link to the full Ofsted report
- Fees, including a daily rate and what is included (meals, nappies, extras)
- Availability: open spaces, limited spaces or a waiting list
- Age range, opening hours, and which government-funded hours are accepted (15 and 30 hours)
- Address, phone number and a way to send an enquiry

Location pages summarise childcare in a county or town: how many nurseries there are, the local range of daily fees, the share rated Outstanding by Ofsted, and the local council's funded-childcare information.

Nurseries list on Toddle for free, and every parent enquiry is passed to the nursery at no charge.

## Start here

- [Find a nursery](https://toddlekids.com/nursery-listing): search every nursery on Toddle by location, age, fees, availability and Ofsted rating
- [Nursery cost calculator](https://toddlekids.com/cost-calculator): estimate weekly, monthly and yearly costs by county, after funded hours and Tax-Free Childcare
- [Nursery groups](https://toddlekids.com/nursery-groups): the UK's larger nursery chains and the nurseries in each
- [Parent guides](https://toddlekids.com/blog): choosing a nursery, settling in, funding and costs
- [List a nursery](https://toddlekids.com/partner-with-toddle): how nurseries join Toddle, free of charge

## Guides for parents

- [New & Expecting Parents: The Complete Guide to Nurseries](https://toddlekids.com/blog/new-and-expecting-parents-guide-to-nurseries): When to register, how to choose, what to ask, and a checklist for nursery visits — everything first-time parents need.
- [What Sets Top Nurseries Apart: A Parent's Guide](https://toddlekids.com/blog/what-sets-top-nurseries-apart-a-parents-guide): Choosing the perfect nursery for your little one is a big deal. Here's how to spot the real gems.
- [Bilingual Nurseries: Raising Little Linguists!](https://toddlekids.com/blog/bilingual-nurseries-raising-little-linguists): Want your little one to be a chatterbox in two languages? Bilingual nurseries could be the answer.
- [Froebelian Nurseries: Nurturing Little Explorers](https://toddlekids.com/blog/froebelian-nurseries-nurturing-little-explorers): A childcare setting that goes beyond traditional daycare — discover the Froebelian approach.
- [Steiner Nurseries: Nurturing Little Imaginations](https://toddlekids.com/blog/steiner-nurseries-nurturing-little-imaginations): A unique and holistic approach to early years that puts imagination at the heart of learning.
- [Unleashing Little Explorers: The Magic of the Curiosity Approach](https://toddlekids.com/blog/unleashing-little-explorers-the-magic-of-the-curiosity-approach): A learning environment where children lead the way and discovery comes first.
- [Outdoor Nurseries: Nurturing Little Nature Lovers](https://toddlekids.com/blog/outdoor-nurseries-nurturing-little-nature-lovers): Magical learning spaces where children play, explore and grow in the great outdoors.
- [Reggio Emilia Nurseries: Where Little Learners Shine](https://toddlekids.com/blog/reggio-emilia-nurseries-where-little-learners-shine): A child-led philosophy from Italy that celebrates creativity and curiosity.
- [Mainstream Nurseries: Your Child's First Big Adventure](https://toddlekids.com/blog/mainstream-nurseries-your-childs-first-big-adventure): Thinking about nursery? It's a big step — and a super exciting one. Here's what to expect.
- [How Much Does Nursery Actually Cost? A Parent's Guide](https://toddlekids.com/blog/how-much-does-nursery-actually-cost-a-parents-guide): Childcare costs can be eye-watering. Here's a transparent breakdown of what to budget.
